QUOTE: **Compile time.** Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define both macros... **Runtime.** Enable only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and call the setter once... "No runtime setter is involved."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair. It never says the two are mutually exclusive. The table shows the function-pointer path applies only when the macros are not both defined, but that is not stated as exclusivity.
